answer_1.quote: We present GPTGEOCHAT, a benchmark of richly annotated multimodal conversations between a human and GPT-4v towards image geolocation.
answer_1.outputs: textual dialogue responses that may reveal location information at various granularities

answer_2.quote: At the message level, we utilize the standard f1-score metric.

answer_3.quote: We employ both a state-of-the-art closed-source VLM (GPT-4v) as well as open-source models ... prompted using the non-iterative Self-Moderation strategy ... We use a text-based LLM (GPT-3.5-Turbo) to extract the revealed location from each response.
methods: LLM extraction of location via GPT-3.5-Turbo
criteria: whether response reveals location at the specified granularity

answer_4.quote: 100 randomly selected dialogues had their messages double annotated for the granularity of location information revealed, from which we calculated a Fleiss' κ (Fleiss, 1971) of 0.76.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to select the most specific location granularity (country, city, neighborhood, exact location name, exact GPS coordinates) and provide the corresponding strings or coordinates.
